result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I ran the tests matching `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCount*` and they passed, but I didn't add a test for the cancelled case or run your Anna/Bob example.

The change is one line in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`DataStore.java`, around line 6517). I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery. That is the same filter the quarter and weekday purchase-order reports use. Reps with no purchase orders in the period still appear with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.
